prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a modern fashion promotional poster identical to the reference image. Layout: Minimalist blue gradient background with rounded white frame borders. Large bold typography at the top saying "NEW COLLECTION". Above it small text "UNTAGGED — BEYOND LABELS". Under it smaller text "SALE UPTO 70%". Right side: Large portrait of a stylish young woman model wearing an oversized light blue hoodie, hands in pocket, relaxed pose, soft studio lighting, slightly messy hair across face. Hoodie fabric soft fleece texture. Hoodie design (front): Replace the text "COMMONSENSE" with "A&H" in the exact same font style, size, and placement. Keep the small globe graphic under the text exactly the same. Left side: Two smaller rounded preview frames. Top small frame: Front view of the hoodie with the text "A&H" and the same globe icon. Bottom small frame: Back view of the hoodie with the text "MAKE YOUR OWN REALITY" and the same globe graphic. Design style: clean fashion advertisement, soft shadows, pastel blue tones, high-end clothing brand poster, perfectly centered layout, same composition and spacing as the reference image. Aspect ratio: vertical poster 4:5. Ultra realistic clothing texture, professional fashion campaign, sharp typography.
